title: Spite and Malice
discardReady: Hand card selected — ready to discard
selectSide: Select a side pile to discard to

settings.cpuSpeedHelp: Adjust how quickly the CPU takes its turn (Slow = 900ms / Normal = 500ms / Fast = 200ms).

frontendHint.goalToFoundation: You can play the top of your goal pile to a foundation
frontendHint.handToFoundation: You can play a card from your hand to a foundation
frontendHint.sideToFoundation: You can play a side pile top to a foundation
frontendHint.discard: No play available. Discard a card to a side pile to end your turn.

tutorial.opponent: Top row is the CPU. You can see how many cards are in their hand and the top of their goal pile.
tutorial.foundations: Center foundations are shared. Any player can build A through Q in sequence. The K is wild and counts as any rank.
tutorial.goal: Your goal pile — the visible top card. The first player to empty their goal pile wins.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Play onto a foundation, or discard to a side pile to end your turn.
tutorial.sides: Your side piles. Discard here at end-of-turn; you can replay them onto foundations later.
